repos_data.description: CoDesign gives AI agents like Claude Code, Codex and PI a real design engine for genuine, editable designs, not flat images. Bring in what you have: InDesign, Photoshop, PowerPoint and PDF files stay editable. Exports print PDFs (CMYK, bleed) and videos. Every design opens in a built-in editor for manual fixes. Runs on your machine, no account.
